verdict: PXE boot failed because the `IssuingCertificateList` registry value is missing on the DP. Without it, SMSPXE cannot validate the PXE media-signing cert against the site's issuer list.
fix: On the MP, read `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\SMS\Security` -> `IssuingCertificateList`. Copy that REG_MULTI_SZ value to the DP: `reg add 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\SMS\Security' /v IssuingCertificateList /t REG_MULTI_SZ /d '<value>' /f`. Restart WDS on the DP. The value is identical across all MP/DP pairs in the same hierarchy, so copying from any healthy MP is safe.
